title: Yellowed Sweet French Milk Macaron
description: A bitter and sweet dessert featuring sweetened condensed milk, with a glassy-jelly texture, inspired by French cuisine, specifically the Burgundy region, and adapted to be low-fat-friendly, this macaron is grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the sweetened condensed milk, granulated sugar, and 1/4 cup of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes or until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the almond flour, confectioners sugar, black food coloring, and salt.
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.
Once cooled, stir in the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Spoon the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a round tip.
Pipe small, round circles onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Tap the baking sheet gently to remove any air bubbles.
Grill the macarons on the binchotan grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the edges are lightly browned.
